Design goals:
- Flyer: photos, strong typography hierarchy (catch 20pt serif, scores 13pt, body 7-8pt), NOT all rectangles — use clip-path angles, border-radius pills/circles, dashed underlines, colored bands with rounded corners on one side only
- Pamphlet: dense 4-page fill with classes matching PamphletDocument.tsx and FlyerDocument.tsx

Brand colors: #006058, #00C1D2 / #00a8b8, #0a3d5c, #c45c26, #9eebf2

Include ALL of these class groups completely:

FLYER FRONT (.fy, .fy-hero, .fy-hero-copy, .fy-hero-media, .fy-hero-photo, .fy-logo-chip, .fy-worry*, .fy-steps*, .fy-core, .fy-reasons*, .fy-bottom, .fy-promo, .fy-results, .fy-foot)
